description: **The gesture layer without the RmlUi host**: decide whether `ui_host.cpp` may install its device hooks and window subclass when `controls.gestures=1` and `ui.enabled=0` (no RmlUi started), relaxing the `test_ui_core.cpp` lint "ui.enabled=0: UiInit returns before any hook", or keep gestures needing `ui.enabled=1` Why: W6 rides on the host's one subclass and Present hook (no second `SetWindowLong`); W2's lint keeps the host unhooked with the UI off, so a game that ships gestures must also ship `ui.enabled=1` Raised: W6 report, 2026-11-03
title: The gesture layer without the RmlUi host
